description.text:
The fourth POP Series set, 17 cards Pokémon Organized Play gave out in packs at its leagues and tournaments. It came out at the 2006 World Championships, where its packs were sold and were prizes on the prize wall, reached sanctioned tournaments in September 2006, and stayed their prize packs for most of the 2006-2007 season.

Every card in the packs is non-holo, Deoxys ex too. Holo copies came later in shop products: Mudkip and Combusken in the EX Value Set (March 2007), Deoxys δ and Mew in EX Power Keepers blisters (March 2007), Wobbuffet in EX Power Keepers two-pack blisters (April 2007), Pikachu in EX Dragon Frontiers blisters (April 2007), and Flygon in the Epic Collection value boxes (May 2007). The Taiwan PokéPark gave its visitors a Chinese-language Pikachu on 23 September 2006, and a Chinese-language Pokémon Fan Club to those who finished its Pokémon Training Course.
